summary: 承接已完成的 mdc-spells 与唯一世界理论，交付统一设备无关意图字段、跨入口等价前提、共同报价/来源/材料/授权/身份/事件反馈合同、六阶段账序及瞄准/暂停恢复/模拟时刻/配置/表现/存档隐私边界。补齐推演台编辑预算单步推演、演武绑定观察及返回同一法术书修订的成功/拒绝/空书/空目标/往返流程，并以相同初态比较修士、法球、机关和敌方修士，覆盖欠费、unknownPrice、域外修复、identityRelation=unknown、DeathBarrier 与旧法术/存档隔离。LabView、CombatView、Battle、Test 仅作现行入口证据；预设和敌方修士留作未来同规则验证，不制作预设、不改游戏或测试。

commands.command: node -e 'const f=require("node:fs"),p=require("node:path"),a=require("node:assert/strict"),b="docs/versions/pilot-agent-intent-2026-09-24/",q=b+"player-bridge-design.md",s=f.readFileSync(q,"utf8"),r=JSON.parse(f.readFileSync(b+"tasks/module-design-mdc-bridge.json","utf8")),plan=JSON.parse(f.readFileSync(b+"module-design-tasks.json","utf8")),spec=plan.tasks.find(x=>x.id==="mdc-bridge"),pred=JSON.parse(f.readFileSync(b+"tasks/module-design-mdc-spells.json","utf8"));a.equal(r.taskId,"mdc-bridge");a.equal(r.status,"completed");a.deepEqual(spec.dependsOn,["mdc-spells"]);a.equal(pred.status,"completed");for(const x of ["actor","program","slot","kind","phase","aim","move","targetHint","simTime","sequence","grant","payer","source","鼠标","键盘","手柄","AI","实体事件","Quote(x)","unknownPrice","unexpressible","identityRelation=unknown","DeathBarrier","六阶段","空书","空目标","旧原件诊断","修士","法球","机关","敌方修士"])a.ok(s.includes(x),x);let n=0;for(const m of s.matchAll(/\]\(([^)]+)\)/g)){const h=m[1].split("#")[0];if(h&&!h.includes("://")){a.ok(f.existsSync(p.resolve(p.dirname(q),h)),h);n++}}for(const e of r.evidence)a.ok(f.existsSync(e),e);a.ok(r.commands.every(x=>x.exitCode===0));console.log("PASS mdc-bridge contract, predecessor, task record, evidence paths and "+n+" local links")'
